integrity: The proof uses an exact complex-scalar recurrence, the strong law of large numbers, and recurrence of the one-dimensional simple symmetric random walk. A standard-library algebra checker is included. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the stated two-dimensional iid two-point linear S-SEG family with equal constant steps; the negative-sign sample operator is not monotone, and the result does not classify general S-SEG.
title: Sharp almost-sure stability boundary for constant-step same-sample extragradient under multiplicative rotation noise
